title: Proving platform gates against live Azure
description: Empirical half of the platform gates. Requires a real subscription, tenant, model deployment, and test identities, so it cannot complete during scaffolding. Prove: G1 actual token audience from VS Code and Azure CLI; G2 observed claim set and client allowlist; G3 interactive sign-in, consent, refresh, sign-out, cancel; G5 llm policy acceptance on Standard v2, per-user counter isolation, and whether daily-quota 403 is distinguishable from RBAC 403; G6 end-to-end correlation join and SSE timing; G7 chunked, compressed, and missing-Content-Length behavior; G8 APIM succeeds while direct Foundry fails from the jumpbox and corporate network; G9 field-level state inspection; G10 canary strings absent from telemetry at max verbosity. Record every result in docs/platform-validation.md and promote rows from Pending to Empirical. Never mark a skipped check as passing.
notes:
Public pattern deployed and verified 2026-09-14. G1/G2 empirical (aud=https://ai.azure.com; ver 1.0 so appid not azp). 14/14 security controls pass live. Streaming + non-streaming work. Correlation ID and Foundry request ID join end-to-end in App Insights. Canary prompt absent from 0 rows with 43 invocation records confirming ingestion. Six APIM platform defects found and fixed. REMAINING: private pattern (G8 anti-bypass), VS Code extension token (G3), quota/throttle behaviour (G5), chunked/compressed bodies (G7), state field inspection (G9).
2026-09-15: BROKERED IDENTITY PROVEN. Re-scoped the subscription-wide Foundry User assignment (Microsoft.CognitiveServices/* dataAction) to 10 resource groups, excluding rg-map-map-public-example. Same human identity, same token: direct Foundry call HTTP 401 BLOCKED; through the gateway HTTP 200 WORKS. All 14 security controls still pass. Bypass now eliminated by capability with NO private networking. Remaining for map-p13: VS Code extension token flow (G3), quota/throttle behaviour (G5), chunked/compressed bodies (G7), private-pattern deployment (G8), state field inspection (G9).

title: Defining contracts and architectures
description: Define the allowlisted Responses request schema, telemetry event schema, and error/status matrix. Produce and validate separate public and private Mermaid architecture contracts showing the unchanged human token, telemetry-only identities, private endpoints outside the PaaS resource, and the direct-backend denial boundary.
close_reason: Request schema, telemetry schema, status matrix, and both validated Mermaid contracts committed.

title: Resolving platform and authentication gates
description: Resolve gates G1-G11 from docs/implementation-plan.md. Highest risk items: official VS Code user-token acquisition for the Foundry audience, same-human Foundry authorization, APIM llm-* policy behavior against the Responses API, secret-free Terraform state, and GA passwordless Windows/Bastion sign-in. Record every finding in docs/platform-validation.md separating documented support, provider-source observation, empirical proof, and unresolved limitation. Stop any portion that lacks documented support and request approval.
notes: Scope narrowed to the documented/source-observed half. All live proofs moved to map-p13, which is blocked until a deployment exists. This keeps scaffolding unblocked without pretending the empirical gates are satisfied.
close_reason: docs/platform-validation.md and docs/versions.md record the documented and source-observed evidence, the version pins, and the G4 conflict. Live proofs tracked in map-p13.

title: Implementing gateway security policies
description: Implement the inbound/outbound/on-error policy chain: canonical correlation, fixed-tenant delegated token validation, trusted identity extraction, spoofable header removal, size and schema validation, model allowlist, store=false enforcement, per-user token governance, unchanged Authorization forwarding, non-buffered SSE, Foundry request-ID capture, and sanitized errors.
close_reason: Policy chain implemented; XML well-formed; security invariants enforced by tests and mutation-verified.

title: Building shared Terraform resources
description: Implement the OpenAI account with custom subdomain and local auth disabled at creation, one explicit model deployment, resource-scoped human RBAC, Log Analytics, workspace-based Application Insights, and APIM Standard v2. Use narrowly justified AzAPI where AzureRM would read authentication keys into state. Grant no inference permissions to any managed identity.
close_reason: Shared Terraform modules implemented: Foundry with local auth disabled, APIM Standard v2, AzAPI-based Log Analytics and subscription handling, telemetry-only identities. terraform validate passes.

title: Scaffolding the repository toolchain
description: Create the repository layout, pin Python/TypeScript/Terraform/azd toolchains, commit lockfiles, and establish local validation commands. Ignore all state, plans, tokens, transcripts, and evidence artifacts.
close_reason: Repository layout, pinned toolchains, committed lockfiles (terraform/uv/npm), and local validation commands in place.

title: Completing review artifacts and lifecycle
description: Complete the README, architecture, security, threat-model, cyber-review, observability, and enterprise-adoption documents. Prove independent clean deployment and teardown of both patterns, the optional test-access toggle, and a prepublication secret review.

title: Implementing validation and guarded CI
description: Implement offline unit, schema, policy-contract, Terraform, and extension tests plus opt-in live integration tests across both deployments. Keep the deployment OIDC identity distinct from the delegated human inference identity. Never report a skipped check as passing.
close_reason: 81 offline tests, mutation-verified invariants, credential-free CI.

title: Establishing payload-free observability
description: Wire W3C correlation, Foundry request-ID capture, low-cardinality token metrics, protected per-user metadata logs, and the six KQL queries against the real emitted schema. Prove nullable usage handling and that no prompt, output, or credential reaches any telemetry path at any verbosity.
close_reason: Six KQL queries plus observability doc recording the real correlation boundary.

title: Implementing Python and curl clients
description: Implement the typed uv-managed Python Responses CLI using an explicit tenant-bound human credential, plus safe curl examples. Callable token refresh, stateless input, correlation and W3C headers, raw response-header access, zero inference retries, and no token echo.
close_reason: Python client and curl examples; ruff/format/mypy strict pass.

title: Implementing VS Code reference extension
description: Build the minimal official VS Code integration using the built-in Microsoft authentication provider for the configured tenant and Foundry scope. Explicit prompt/selection consent, unchanged user token, streaming output, session refresh, cancellation, metadata-only diagnostics, zero inference retries, and no token persistence.
close_reason: VS Code extension using built-in Microsoft auth; tsc strict passes.

title: Building private deployment and test access
description: Implement isolated private networking: dedicated APIM integration subnet, private endpoints for APIM and OpenAI, private DNS, and anti-bypass NSG rules that deny direct OpenAI access from the jumpbox and connected corporate networks. Add the parameterized default-on Windows VM and Bastion test access. Blocked on gate G4 until GA passwordless sign-in and secret-free bootstrap are proven.
close_reason: Private networking with anti-bypass NSGs and parameterized test access implemented. Live proof and G4 decision pending in map-p13.

title: Wiring public azd deployment
description: Deliver the independently deployable public environment: infrastructure-only azure.yaml with the Terraform provider, nonsecret preflight checks, fresh azd up, idempotent reapply, and azd down. Document the direct-backend bypass as an intentional public-sample residual risk.
close_reason: azure.yaml infrastructure-only with fail-closed preflight, profile examples, postprovision verification guidance. Live azd up pending in map-p13.
